input.summary: Add licence-back for Commerce One-owned Developments and limit any Commerce One licence in Corio data.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 13.5 lets Commerce One take ownership of coding Corio creates (and leaves Corio-developed enhancements to later negotiation) with no licence back, so we have added our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those Developments for our business, plus a limit confining any Commerce One licence in our data to processing it solely to provide the services.

ops.text: To the extent Commerce One owns or retains ownership of any Developments, enhancements, modifications or derivative works developed by Corio under this Section 13, Commerce One grants Corio a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the same for Corio's business. Any license granted to Commerce One in data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Corio or its Customers is limited to processing that data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
